title: Trial Fable advisor on Opus lanes against first-push-green
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/advisor-and-model-features-2026-11-16.md (operator request 2026-11-16: "sprawdz czym jest advisor mode w fable"). Claude Code's advisor (`advisorModel` setting, `claude --advisor fable`, CC 2.1.321+) lets an Opus 5.5 lane consult Fable 5.2 mid-task; subagents inherit it.
Outcome: a trial of 10 lane tasks with `advisorModel: fable` against 10 without prints first-push-green share, CI rounds per PR and Fable cost per PR for both arms (`krn ledger --first-push-green` over the trial PRs), and the lead records keep/drop with that evidence.
Why: the advisor targets exactly the friction metric (rules missed before push) at a known price (~$0.80 per call at 100k context).
Proof: the trial report file under .krn/runs/research/ lists both arms with the three numbers.
Files: .claude/settings.json, src/cli/lane-run.ts, .krn/runs/research/
